verdict.rationale: Aider gives only indirect, workaround-level support. `/run` executes commands and shares their output with the model, `/web` can scrape a page into the chat, and screenshots can be added for visual context. There is no evidence of attaching to a running web app, inspecting its runtime state or browser, or setting breakpoints. Missing for 10: live process/debugger attachment, browser devtools or runtime inspection of a running web app, breakpoint/stepping support, any hands-on corroboration of debugging a live app.
